summary: The named genera exist as fossil occurrences in PBDB (Scaphites 395, Ancyloceras 54, Lituites 46, Oekotraustes 9) and Scaphites has thousands of museum photographs on GBIF and iDigBio, but MorphoSource holds no scan under any of the four genus names. Open ontogenetic shell-measurement datasets exist only for other ammonoids (Dryad: early Devonian forms, one Kosmoceras CT), so the uncoiling and narrowing trajectories of the claim's taxa have no tabulated data.
next_step: Decide whether to test on photographed Scaphites specimens (outline extraction from GBIF/iDigBio images) or compile ontogenetic outline measurements from the heteromorph literature; pre-register how the local spiral angle is estimated from an outline.
obstacles_confirmed: No 3D scans of the named heteromorph genera in MorphoSource (zero hits per name).
